threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You ask for a flat white at the café and get an odd look instead of a smile. It's all about the latest artisanal brew, mate.
Last night on the 59, a guy sang Wonderwall to a traffic cone for 20 minutes. The driver just shook his head and laughed.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I found a cat perched on a traffic light in Neukölln, just watching the world go by. It felt like the ultimate local vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a spontaneous techno party in an abandoned factory on a Tuesday night, complete with street art and local DJs.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they can name three taco trucks off the top of their head, but a visitor still thinks burritos are the only option.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 on Eddy this morning with a sax player jamming right at the back. Everyone was grinning, even the guy in a suit. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just about the parks and pretty streets, but the locals know it's about the hidden bars and late-night xurros in the corners.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by the way they stare at the tram like it's a spaceship. Regulars just glide past, barely noticing.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can tell a newbie by how they still call it 'the Tube' instead of just 'the Overground' for local routes.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Clapham, and the guy across from me was trying to impress a girl with a sax solo. It was more cringe than cool, but the bus driver nodded along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw an ancient lady knitting at the bus stop while a group of teens freestyled in perfect sync. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you'll find spontaneous techno parties in hidden courtyards, often popping up with just a few hours' notice. It's a true Berlin vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're locals when they know which taco trucks only serve birria after 10 PM and how to jump BART delays by cycling through the Mission.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: I saw a guy juggling on the bus while the driver was stuck at a red light. He finished a trick just as the light turned green. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí. They miss the hidden plazas where locals sip vermut, while the tourists rush by on their way to the big sights.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new when they still look puzzled at the chaotic tram schedules; locals just shrug and hop on the next one.
